statement: Seed-0 runtime remains deterministic. The first real learned token artifacts exist only as measured experimental organs and have no tool or runtime authority. Static typed compatibility, dynamic typed route readiness, missing-readiness-hand planning, exact provider-declaration affordance planning, consumer-bound provider-declaration gap planning, independent provider-declaration research-exam planning, bounded read-only declaration architecture surveying, bounded static provider implementation-evidence surveying, balanced provider-binding experiment planning, attributed human review sealing, and reviewed disposable candidate construction are separate deterministic organs. The affordance planner can propose AVAILABLE-at-most structural-probe inputs only from a unique exact typed provider declaration; consumer or name signals hold and no proposal is a human review. The provider-declaration hand planner may expose a demanded declaration relation only when exact consumers coexist with zero exact providers; it leaves provider identity, schema, path, and implementation unresolved and cannot build or write them. The research-exam planner turns such a hand into four untested architecture hypotheses and ten held-out case families, but selects no architecture, lets no future candidate author its own expected outcomes or held-out fixtures, and builds or executes nothing. The architecture survey assesses each bounded, content-digested Workshop shared JSON document independently, preserves malformed and refused sources, rejects cross-document relation merging and frequency-based selection, and leaves every hypothesis UNTESTED. Even a complete current-relation witness is not architecture evaluation. The following implementation-evidence survey records exact demanded-selector literals and conservative export, registration, require, assertion, and selftest-path syntax from bounded content-digested Workshop shared JavaScript without executing it. A selector source is evidence only: it does not bind the outer provider requirement, infer provider identity, select an implementation by frequency, or evaluate architecture. The balanced experiment planner then joins every eligible exported selector source to every positive UNTESTED architecture hypothesis and the independently authored case families. Tests remain validation-only and every provider identity, outer binding, declaration schema and path, permission set, and frame selection remains unresolved; no source executes, architecture is evaluated, provider is built, or trace enters training. A separate attributed HUMAN review bridge can seal only APPROVE_DISPOSABLE_EXECUTOR or HOLD against the exact current exam. Approval admits one fixed relation executor under ignored private state; the independent builder copies the pre-candidate ten-case exam into synthetic fixtures and caps positive output at STRUCTURALLY_DECLARED_AVAILABLE_AT_MOST. Passing those fixtures proves instrument discrimination only: no provider architecture is selected or evaluated, no provider or declaration is built, and no readiness, live execution, Workshop write, training, installation, or promotion authority is created. Reasoning-experience v5 separates expected-decision agreement from observed outcome success, and the source-bound failure-curriculum organ may propose a narrow curriculum, hardcoded-organ admission, or cause-and-repair exam only after recurrent independently evaluated real-local negative evidence; it cannot train, build, select, install, promote, grant, or act. The readiness-probe review bridge separately binds a human-supplied decision to the current hand, and its builder may write only deterministic probe candidate and fixture bytes under ignored state after exact attributed review; it cannot infer a recipe, touch Workshop, run live, install, start, repair, grant, train, act in the world, or promote anything.
